Ball 1 starts in slot 1, so win chance = 1⁄3.  Ball 2 starts in slot 2: win = 1⁄3 + (2⁄3)(1⁄3) = 5⁄9.  Any ball that first appears in slot 3 (balls 3–100) has win = 1⁄3 + (1⁄3)(5⁄9) + (1⁄3)(1⁄3) = 17⁄27, the highest possible. The earliest such ball is number 3.
A ball’s chance of piston-ejection depends only on the platform position where it first appears.  
• Entering in position 1 ⇒ 1⁄3 chance.  
• Entering in position 2 ⇒ 5⁄9 chance.  
• Entering in position 3 ⇒ 17⁄27 chance (the maximum possible).  
The initial loading places ball 1 in position 1, ball 2 in position 2, and ball 3 in position 3.  All later balls reach positions 2 or 3 with mixed probabilities that never give them a certainty of starting in position 3, so their maximum attainable ejection probability is below 17⁄27.  Therefore the highest overall probability belongs to ball 3.

• 2.Re1 allows 2…Qxe1+, again picking up the rook with check.
• 2.Kh2 (or any king move) lets Black continue with …Nf3+ followed by …Bxc4, leaving Black a piece-up and with an unstoppable attack.  
Thus 1…Qa1+ forces decisive material gains and guarantees the win.
The winning continuation starts with the queen infiltration on the first rank:
1… Qa1+
